neet_phy_u03_t06_2.working: Vertical balance: T cos60° = mg, so T = 5 / 0.5 = 10 N

neet_phy_u03_t06_3.working: Centripetal force is perpendicular to velocity, so W = 0. After half a revolution the velocity reverses, so |Δp| = 2mv = 2 × 2 × 3 = 12 kg m/s

neet_phy_u03_t06_4.working: A is true: with no force, the stone continues along its instantaneous velocity, which is tangential (inertia). R is true but does not explain the tangential escape.

neet_phy_u03_t06_5.working: I: ω = 4π rad/s, F = mω²r = 1 × 16π² × 0.5 = 8π² N, so correct. II: F ∝ v²/r gives 4 / (1/2) = 8 times, not 4, so incorrect.
